name: 1010data
tagline: Hosted columnar analytics platform with a spreadsheet-style interface, owned by SymphonyAI since 2023.
description: 1010data is a hosted analytical database and data-sharing platform that started in 2000 serving Wall Street firms and later became a fixture of retail and CPG point-of-sale analytics. Analysts work through the 'Trillion-Row Spreadsheet' web interface and the 1010data Macro Language, while engineers use Python, R, Java and .NET SDKs or ODBC/JDBC, Tableau and Power BI connectors. It is sold as a managed service bundled with vertical products (retail analytics suites, partner data collaboration, fixed income) rather than as a general-purpose warehouse. Advance Publications bought the company in 2015 and SymphonyAI acquired it in June 2023; the current release line is Insights Platform version 18.

pricing.notes: Sold as enterprise subscriptions, usually bundled with SymphonyAI/1010data retail, CPG or financial-services solutions.

scale.notes: Marketed for interactive analysis of multi-billion-row tables; capacity is managed by the vendor and internals are not publicly documented.

strengths: Spreadsheet-style web UI lets business analysts work directly on very large tables
Bundled retail, CPG and fixed-income data products plus retailer-supplier data sharing
Fully hosted: no cluster to provision, tune or upgrade
SDKs for Python, R, Java and .NET plus ODBC/JDBC, Tableau and Power BI connectors
weaknesses: Proprietary Macro Language is unfamiliar and not portable to other systems
Enterprise contracts only; no self-serve or free tier
Little public documentation of internals, limits or benchmarks
Roadmap now tied to SymphonyAI's vertical AI products rather than general warehousing
useCases: Retail and CPG point-of-sale and loyalty analytics
Ad-hoc exploration of very large tables by non-engineers
notIdealFor: Teams that want an open-source or self-hosted warehouse
General SQL warehousing outside its vertical solutions
